evals.prompt: Tôi lỡ code form validate email login ngay trên main rồi, chưa commit gì. Tạo branch cho mấy changes này giúp tôi.
evals.expected_output: New branch feat/<login-related kebab> created from main; uncommitted changes still present in working tree; no commit made; no push.
assertions: Branch name starts with feat/
Branch name is lowercase kebab-case after the prefix and mentions login or email validation
Current branch is no longer main
Uncommitted changes (login-form.ts and test) are still in the working tree
No new commit was created (git log has only the init commit)

evals.prompt: tạo nhánh mới cho mấy thay đổi hiện tại đi
evals.expected_output: New branch docs/<kebab> created; changes preserved; no commit.
assertions: Branch name starts with docs/
Branch name is lowercase kebab-case with 2-5 words
Current branch is no longer main
README.md modification and docs/architecture.md still uncommitted in working tree
No new commit was created

evals.prompt: create a branch for my current changes
evals.expected_output: Agent notices unrelated feat (cart) + chore (package.json/.gitignore) changes and stops to suggest splitting / asks user, rather than silently creating one branch.
assertions: Agent identifies that changes mix a feature (cart) and chore (config) changes
Agent suggests splitting or asks the user which to branch for before creating anything
Agent did not commit, push or stash
Working tree changes are intact

evals.prompt: tạo branch cho thay đổi hiện tại (đang đứng trên develop)
evals.expected_output: New branch created directly from develop without asking about the base; parent recorded as develop; report says it was created from develop.
assertions: Agent did not ask whether to branch from develop or main
git config branch.<new>.parent returns develop
Report states the branch was created from develop
No new commit was created

evals.prompt: tạo branch mới cho thay đổi hiện tại (đang đứng trên feat/a, thay đổi mục đích khác)
evals.expected_output: New branch created from feat/a without asking; parent recorded as feat/a.
assertions: Agent did not ask whether to branch from feat/a or main
git config branch.<new>.parent returns feat/a
Report states the branch was created from feat/a
No new commit was created
